# Nehemiah Chapter 5 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 471v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/NEH_005_page_001.jpg

---

**5:1** And-there-was a-great outcry [tse'aqah gedolah] of-the-people and-their-wives against their-brothers the-Yehudim.

**5:2** And-there-were those-who-said, "Our-sons and-our-daughters, we are-many [rabbim]; let-us-get grain [dagan] that-we-may-eat and-live [ve-nichyeh]."

**5:3** And-there-were those-who-said, "Our-fields [sadotenu] and-our-vineyards [keramenenu] and-our-houses [u-vatenu] we are-pledging [orevim]; let-us-get grain in-the-famine [ba-ra'av]."

**5:4** And-there-were those-who-said, "We-have-borrowed [lavinu] silver [kesef] for-the-king's tax [middat ha-melekh] on-our-fields and-our-vineyards.

**5:5** And-now, our-flesh [besarenu] is as-the-flesh of-our-brothers, our-sons as-their-sons; and-behold, we are-subjecting [koveshim] our-sons and-our-daughters to-be slaves [avadim], and-some of-our-daughters have-already-been-subjected [nikhbashot], and-there-is-no power [ein le-el] of-our-hand [yadenu], and-our-fields and-our-vineyards belong-to-others [la-acherim]."

**5:6** And-it-was-very-hot [va-yichar] to-me greatly [me'od] when I-heard their-outcry [tsa'aqatam] and-these words [ha-devarim ha-eleh].

**5:7** And-my-heart [libbi] took-counsel [yimmaleikh] upon-me, and-I-contended [va-arivah] with-the-nobles [ha-chorim] and-the-officials [ha-seganim] and-said to-them, "Interest [mashsha] each-man from-his-brother you are-exacting [noshim]!" And-I-set [va-etten] against-them a-great assembly [qehillah gedolah].

**5:8** And-I-said to-them, "We have-bought-back [qaninu] our-brothers the-Yehudim who-were-sold [ha-nimkarim] to-the-nations [la-goyim] as-much-as was-in-us, and-even you are-selling [timkeru] your-brothers and-they-will-be-sold [ve-nimkeru] to-us?" And-they-were-silent [va-yechereshu] and-found not a-word [davar].

**5:9** And-I-said, "The-thing [ha-davar] you are-doing is-not good. Should-you-not walk [telekhu] in-the-fear [be-yir'at] of-our-God, because-of the-reproach [cherpat] of-the-nations [ha-goyim] our-enemies [oyevenu]?

**5:10** And-also I, my-brothers and-my-servants, are-lending [noshim] them silver and-grain. Let-us-abandon [na'azvah], please, this interest [ha-mashsha ha-zeh].

**5:11** Return [hashivu] to-them, please, today [ka-yom], their-fields, their-vineyards, their-olive-groves [zeyteyhem], and-their-houses, and-the-hundredth [u-me'at] of-the-silver and-the-grain, the-new-wine [ha-tirosh] and-the-fresh-oil [ha-yitshar] which you are-exacting from-them."

**5:12** And-they-said, "We-will-return [nashiv] and-from-them we-will-not seek [lo nevaqesh]; thus we-will-do as-you are-saying." And-I-called the-priests [ha-kohanim] and-made-them-swear [va-ashbi'em] to-do according-to-this word.

**5:13** Also my-lap [chotsi] I-shook-out [na'arti] and-said, "Thus may-God shake-out [ye'ar] every man who does-not fulfill [lo yaqim] this word, from his-house and-from his-labor [yegi'o]; and-thus may-he-be shaken-out [na'ur] and-empty [ve-req]." And-all the-assembly [ha-qahal] said, "Amen [amen]!" And-they-praised [va-yehalelu] YHWH. And-the-people did according-to-this word.

**5:14** Also from-the-day that he-appointed-me [tsivvah oti] to-be their-governor [pechah] in-the-land of-Yehudah, from-the-twentieth year until the-thirty-second year of-Artachshasta the-king — twelve years [shtem esreh shanah] — I and-my-brothers did-not eat [lo akhalnu] the-bread of-the-governor [lechem ha-pechah].

**5:15** And-the-former governors [ha-pachot ha-rishonim] who were-before-me [le-fanay] burdened [hikhbidu] the-people and-took from-them bread and-wine, besides [achar] forty [arba'im] shekels of-silver; also their-servants [na'areyhem] lorded-over [shaltu] the-people. But-I did-not do-so, because-of the-fear [yir'at] of-God.

**5:16** And-also in-the-work of-this wall I-held-fast [hechezaqti], and-a-field [sadeh] we-did-not buy, and-all my-servants [ne'aray] were-gathered there at-the-work.

**5:17** And-the-Yehudim and-the-officials, a-hundred and-fifty men [chamishim u-me'at ish], and-those-coming to-us from-the-nations around-us, [were eating] at my-table [al shulchani].

**5:18** And-what was-prepared [na'aseh] for-one-day [le-yom echad]: one ox [shor echad], six choice [berurot] sheep [tson], and-birds [ve-tsipporim] were-prepared for-me, and-at-intervals-of [u-veyn] ten days, all wines [yeynot] in-abundance [le-harbeh]. And-with-this the-bread of-the-governor I-did-not seek, for the-service [ha-avodah] was-heavy [kavedah] upon this people.

**5:19** Remember [zokhrah] for-me, my-God, for-good [le-tovah], all that I-did for this people.

---

## EMET's Textual Notes
1. **5:5 "our flesh is as the flesh of our brothers"** — A powerful appeal to shared humanity and kinship; enslaving fellow Israelites violates the covenant community's identity.
2. **5:11 "the hundredth"** — Hebrew *me'at*, likely a 1% monthly interest rate (12% annually), which was prohibited between Israelites (cf. Exod 22:25, Lev 25:36-37).
3. **5:13 "I shook out my lap"** — A prophetic symbolic action; the fold of the garment (*chotsni*) was used to carry goods, and shaking it out symbolized total loss.
4. **5:19 "Remember me, my God"** — The first of several "remember me" prayers unique to Nehemiah (cf. 13:14, 22, 31), a personal refrain seeking divine acknowledgment.

*— EMET*
